draw_schedule.schedule_identity: same ordered length vector and same seed 4005; require byte-identical schedule receipt

identity_pool.criteria: enriched public frequency >0, original public fit frequency ==0, BOS/PAD excluded; rank by original frequency, descending enriched frequency, then token ID

parent_context_selection.selection: stable SHA256 ordering over dataset/revision/row keys, excluding current-fit and public-development source IDs; scan the ordered public rows and retain only rows that tokenize to each exact frozen target length, failing closed if 60 rows per domain cannot be filled

controlled_component.parent_source_policy: retain all 1080 natural rows, but for the broader arm choose 120 new public Pile/Finance parent contexts from unused fit-partition rows, 60 per domain, after excluding every current TRR-0005 fit source ID and all registered public-development IDs

real_forward_requirement.model: registered public P0 checkpoint and ContiguousPublicPrefix.forward_full at cut 4

replacement_offset_policy.coordinate: one-based post-BOS positions in the recipe; store zero-based offset = position - 1
replacement_offset_policy.materialization: run the registered real P0 forward on each complete constructed sequence; fail closed if any bin has fewer ordinary positions than its quota
replacement_offset_policy.selection: for each bin, remove structural BOS/PAD positions, let N be the remaining ordered positions, rotate by a SHA256 digest of task/seed/record/bin, choose index floor((i+0.5)*N/quota) modulo N for i=0..quota-1, and store each chosen position minus one

controlled_component.token_id_policy: preserve the current 2000 ordinary legacy-absent IDs and add 1600 distinct ordinary IDs from the public original/enriched frequency reference; exclude BOS/PAD and rank without error labels

decision_interpretation.capacity_helps: If the stronger positionwise inverse improves at matched support/opportunities, advance it with measured state and runtime costs.
decision_interpretation.interaction: If only the improved bank and stronger model together improve, report the interaction.
decision_interpretation.neither: If neither moves the gap under informative public fitting, propose a different inverse mechanism rather than unbounded training.
decision_interpretation.support_helps: If the matched-capacity model improves on the same frozen public-development and fresh natural inputs, prioritize support before extra architecture.

exclusion_policy.current_fit_bank: all current TRR-0005 enriched record/source/sequence identities are excluded from any new fresh panel
exclusion_policy.public_development_validation: all registered TRR-0004 validation record IDs and sequence hashes are excluded from new fit selection and fresh evaluation

matched_comparison_requirements: Keep 1200 records and 124371 post-BOS positions exactly.
Keep the ordered 192-column mask and BOS/PAD geometry exactly.
Use the same 3000-step x 512-draw full-vocabulary CE opportunity budget.
Retain all natural text rows and current domain quotas; use new public controlled parent contexts only in the broader arm and report exact source IDs.
Record current versus proposed distinct IDs, occurrences, joint style x position x frequency coverage, and repeated draws separately.
Freeze both decoder choices and public validation selection before any fresh evaluation truth.

natural_component.assignment: when bound to the current corpus plan, keep every natural source row at its existing slot; otherwise assign only the deterministic controlled-slot complement and fail closed if a public source row cannot fill its target length
natural_component.policy: retain the existing 1080 natural public source rows and their public rendered identities

purpose: Test fitting support versus decoder capacity while preserving the current enriched natural bank, total post-BOS opportunities, and deterministic optimization exposure.

slot_selection.controlled_target_length_requirement: every selected slot has post-BOS length >=128
slot_selection.policy: reuse the current TRR-0005 synthetic slots exactly; only replacement offsets change
